name: Watchlist Deletion (Preview)
overview: Native Jellyfin watchlists, notifications and consent-based removal queues. Discord is a separate optional plugin. Preview.
description: Standalone Jellyfin 12.2 / .NET 10 watchlist and deletion core. Requires separately installed File Transformation (>=2.2.1.0) and Plugin Pages (>=3.0.0.0) for native Web controls and pages. No Discord or Private SyncPlay installation is required for native watchlists, notifications or queue maintenance. Deletion defaults to owned Seerr requests; an explicit administrator grant permits verified accessible native movies or whole series. Recent-viewer consent, the full delay and approved exact Arr file APIs remain mandatory; automatic removal defaults off. Separate administrator evidence and authenticated transition history preserve explicit legacy gaps. The Discord Integration owns its configuration/Activity surfaces and depends on this plugin's versioned API and Private SyncPlay. Retained Media Hub identity and durable state are preserved with additive schema-14 journal and explicit configuration-custody records. Full split runtime acceptance remains pending; this is not a production-certified release.
